description: Tru learns the rules of her involuntary second chances while balancing the morgue, family and friends, repeatedly reliving fatal days to discover who actually needs saving and why.

s01e01.description: A murdered woman asks Tru for help in the morgue, and Tru wakes at the start of the same day with a chance to prevent the killing.

s01e02.description: Another plea from the dead sends Tru back into a day where a deadly fire is only part of the danger she must untangle.

s01e03.description: Tru’s second chance at a fatal day becomes entangled with family loyalties, forcing her to decide whom the victim was really trying to save.

s01e04.description: A new request for help sends Tru into a case whose present-day danger is rooted in events and relationships from the past.

s01e05.description: Tru investigates a death with an unsettling supernatural edge while trying to determine which apparently obvious explanation is wrong.

s01e06.description: A doomed romance becomes Tru’s next repeating day, leaving her to separate genuine love from the choices leading toward tragedy.

s01e07.description: Tru wakes into another chance to alter a fatal morning, with the previous night’s missing pieces becoming the key to the victim’s fate.

s01e08.description: A plea from the morgue gives Tru one day to uncover unfinished business and prevent grief from hardening into another irreversible loss.

s01e09.description: The danger reaches Tru’s workplace when a death connected to the morgue turns her familiar refuge into the center of the case.

s01e10.description: A school reunion pulls Tru into old grudges and old relationships as she tries to identify which history is about to become lethal.

s01e11.description: Tru is forced through an unusually difficult repeating day in which changing one outcome keeps exposing another way events can go wrong.

s01e12.description: A Valentine’s Day death turns romance into a puzzle of jealousy, expectation and timing that Tru must solve before the day ends again.

s01e13.description: A beauty-related death gives Tru another day to investigate appearances, rivalries and the motives hidden behind an apparently glamorous setting.
